propositions: Description cap is sourced from config key verify.max_ticket_description_chars (default 8000) and read by both the plan-review admission guard and the new save-time warning

When a ticket description exceeds the configured cap on create or edit and the plan-review claim gate is enabled, a warning is emitted at save time (after write succeeds) stating length, cap, and that claim will require a passing review
Warning is not shown when gate is disabled, description is within cap, or ticket type is exempt from plan review; warning never blocks or alters the write
Warning surfaces on all channels: CLI stderr, library logger (rebar root), and MCP result fields (CreateResultOut and WriteAckOut)
Documentation updated and test coverage includes gate-on and gate-off scenarios, config key respect, exempt types, and roundtrip validation
